Hat Manufacturer in Mexico for the United States

Hatmex is a Mexican private-label hat manufacturer with over 10 years of experience exporting to the United States, Canada, Australia, and Brazil. We craft handmade hats in bangora, shantung, palm, jap paper, wool, rabbit felt, and beaver felt from our facility in León, Guanajuato, with fast delivery through our warehouse in Eagle Pass, Texas.

Frequently Asked Questions

We work with premium wool, bangora, woven palm, rabbit and beaver felt, and jap. Each material is selected based on the client's style, intended use, and budget.
